summary: The revived tame stone giant skips dog.c:wary_dog at zero-based step 98. C consumes rn2(1) and makes the hero-killed pet untamed and peaceful; JavaScript leaves it tame and advances to the next exercise draw. Its later pet pickup of the boulder stops before step 99 with a missing recalcBlockPoint hook. Port whole wary_dog and wire the existing corpse/statue revival callers; keep the separate pickup hook defect and unported life-saving entry explicit.

Its rn2(1)=0 makes this revived giant peaceful; was_dead suppresses messages.

Reuse existing cansee/canspotmon, haseyes, body_part, monster naming and newsym owners. Preserve every wary_dog RNG gate, starvation healing, tameness/peacefulness transition, message, leash/steed branch and EDOG reset in source order.

Read whole dog.c:wary_dog 1292-1360. C first calls finish_meating even for an untame monster, heals the EDOG starvation penalty, then chooses the killed/abused arm or random tameness arm. An untamed result redraws and ends leash/mount relations; a still-tame result resets revival, abuse, goal and hunger state and, when dead, drop/whistle/apport state.

C mon.c:xkilled 3526 sets EDOG.killed_by_u=1 before death; js/mon.js:5890 stores true. Corpse saved traits restored by montraits carry this flag. With abuse=0, C wary_dog clears mtame and mpeaceful, rn2(1)=0 restores mpeaceful, and was_dead=TRUE suppresses the life-saving messages. The giant resumes ordinary-monster movement instead of pet inventory behavior.

Accepted source search rg for wary_dog in js finds only named gaps in zap.js and trap.js, with no definition in dog.js. The existing mon.c:lifesaved_monster owner still refuses amulet life-saving, so whole wary_dog plus its existing revive/animate_statue callers is actionable while that production entry remains explicitly blocked.

The replay later stops with recalcBlockPoint is not available for otyp 475 before step 99 newline; the final JS screen is The stone giant corpse glows iridescently.--More--. This later extraction-hook defect remains unresolved and may become unreachable for this case after wary_dog; do not erase it or substitute a boulder fix for the earlier RNG cause.

Whole-function evidence must include independent saved-traits corpse and statue revival entry witnesses, cheap killed/abused versus still-tame variations, and source-derived tests for any new pure helpers. This case establishes only the quiet hero-killed-pet arm.
